name: Transformer oil-surge trip interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Transfers the applicable gas relay's oil-surge trip indication to the assigned protection logic.
description: Transfers the applicable gas relay's oil-surge trip indication to the assigned protection logic. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Oil-surge relay contact” at the input and “Assigned transformer trip initiation” at the output. Gas alarm and oil-surge trip are distinct outputs.
